sentences.text: Adeopapposaurus is a genus of plateosaurian dinosaur with a long neck, meaning 'far eating lizard'.
Scientists know of four partial skeletons and two partial skulls of Adeopapposaurus.
The dinosaur Adeopapposaurus was described in 2009 by paleontologist Ricardo N. Martínez.
Bone structure at the jaw tips suggests Adeopapposaurus possessed keratinous beaks.
Adeopapposaurus is classified within the family Massospondylidae.
The parent group of Adeopapposaurus is the family Massospondylidae.
Adeopapposaurus lived between 201.4 and 174.7 million years ago during the Hettangian to Toarcian stages.
